title: 3 Order Block Mistakes Killing Your Funded Account (2026)
description: Most traders are using order blocks wrong — and it's costing them funded accounts. R2F Trading breaks down the 3 mistakes smart money traders never make. Follow for daily ICT setups. Link in bio → r2ftrading.com
script: Three funded accounts. Blown. Same mistake every time. Order blocks — but not the ones you think. Mistake one. Trading every order block you see. Not all OBs are created equal. Only mitigated ones matter. If price already tapped that OB once — it's done. Move on. Most traders re-enter it. Smart money already left. Mistake two. No liquidity sweep before the entry. If there's no sweep — there's no confirmation. Period. Watch for buyside or sellside liquidity getting grabbed first. That sweep is smart money loading. That's your signal. Mistake three. Ignoring the fair value gap above or below the OB. The FVG tells you WHERE price is actually going. Stack all three — unmitigated OB, liquidity sweep, FVG target — and your win rate shifts fast. The R2F Trading system is built on exactly this. Follow R2F Trading. New ICT setups every day. Full system at r2ftrading.com — link in bio.
